Two of California's major recreational waterways, the Sacramento and American Rivers, are nearby. The dominant positive force near the site is the County Medical School, which is linked closely with the Medical School of the University of California at Davis. The County Medical School is developing a center at the westerly end of the Fairground area.
The site topography is flat. The surrounding residential area consists of single-family detached homes in a rectilinear grid pattern. The site plan utilizes cluster planning based on a similar grid with perimeter roadways and a central greenway providing pedestrian access to recreational areas and the community center.

This site occupies two neighboring parcels of 7.6 acres and 7.9 acres in the Mill Creek Urban Renewal Area in downtown St. Louis. This is a slum clearance and redevelopment project with all structures in the project area having been demolished and removed from the parcels. The site is located near one of the best rowhouse developments in the country, LaClede Town, a new, well-planned housing development that has been highly successful in revitalizing this neighborhood near the downtown area. St. Louis University is located on one edge of the site.
The BREAKTHROUGH properties have been planned as part of the total community environment, and provide park and recreational space to the surrounding areas. The design groups parking around the periphery of the properties, and creates an internal court system with changing vistas for the pedestrian.
